comment: Spell registry example: Kiln registry fields only (docs/kiln/modding/registries/abilities.md). Fireball I's cast (game:attack_player_staff_fixedanim_fireball_fast) releases its projectile at 0.45 s instead of 0.65 s and pays its mana at the same moment: every spawn and every payment at their first moment move with the field (mods/samples/SpellTweaks moves each event by its kiln.gamedata path instead). The buffs are in SpellRegistryMod.cs.
